messages:
Alex: Quick sync for Vega Systems POC. They want to bring a custom 27B-v2 quant variant (claims q5_0) and validate p95 latency <200ms for 512 tokens. Also asking for EU data residency, customer KMS, and SSO via SAML. Any immediate concerns?
Priya: tokenize first. ask them to drop tokenizer.json, merges, and sample inputs. q5_0 is new to our bench—Triton kernels might not be optimized. need quant scheme artifact and whether they compressed vocab.
Sam: for compatibility i'll need model bundle: model.tar (config.json + tokenizer), weights (.pth or GGML/ONNX), and an ops_manifest if they used custom CUDA ops. checklist: attention type (rotary/alibi), kvcache layout, rotary base, norm epsilon.
Maya: privacy note: EU residency -> recommend Private or Dedicated in eu-west. Hosted with egress controls possible but KMS with customer keys in hosted mode is an approval path. Legal will need the SAML metadata and KMS SLA asks.
Ravi: pricing POV: for a 2-week POC with ~800 qps bursts but low average concurrency, propose hosted with burst tier + 1-week dedicated staging slot. estimate cost ballpark: hosted baseline + equivalent of 8 dedicated cards/day for short windows. i can draft numbers.
Alex: they also want a canary A/B compare against their current endpoint to measure quality and latency. we'll need side-by-side logs and identical prompt sets. can we do a feature-flagged route?
Sam: yes - we can route by policy and record per-route traces. will enable deterministic seeds and token-level timings. also log sampling decisions for reproducibility.
Priya: ops heads-up: quantized paging + KV cache may exceed default GPU mem. recommend starting with 80GB aggregate (A10s or A100p3x) or enable sharded kv + weight offload. continuous batching on small window recommended.
Maya: security blocker: customer-managed KMS on hosted requires legal review (~10 biz days). if they need KMS before POC, suggest Dedicated in eu-west as alternative. also need to confirm retention: they want data auto-delete after 30 days. we have retention API but legal must sign.
Sam: quick tech checklist i'm going to run after we get artifacts:
- validate tokenizer.vocab_size == config.vocab_size
- confirm kv cache layout and rotary dims
- perf pass: seq=512, concurrency 8, beam=1, sampling off
- verify embeddings dim if they use embeddings endpoint
- check model outputs for EOS/special token handling
Also note: if embedding_dim != our vec size we'll need mapping for cross-model retrieval.
Alex: also ask them for a minimal test harness with 20 representative prompts and a gold set to compute quality delta.
Ravi: draft pricing and POC SOW: 2-week POC, hosted metered + 3-day dedicated staging, up to 1M tokens/day included, extra usage billed. include optional dedicated quote. i'll draft and share.
Priya: blocker: if they used custom CUDA kernels or fused attention we'll need eng build or a wrapper; add ~4 days.
Maya: blocker: SAML/SSO metadata + okta config required from customer before private deployment.
Sam: blocker: tokenizer mismatch or extra special tokens. we can patch with tokenizer adapter but that changes token counts -> impacts latency estimates.
Alex: timeline proposed: artifacts by Thu, compatibility pass Fri-Mon, demo Wed. does that work?
Ravi: works for me. i'll send draft SOW + cost sheet today.
Maya: i'll prep legal checklist and ask for the security questionnaire answers.
Priya: i'll put together a short runbook for the bench engineers with recommended GPU profiles and toggles (continuous_batching=true, prefix_kv_cache=true).
Alex: great. i'll message Vega with requested artifact list and timeline. thanks all :rocket:
